Title: How to Access your Earned Wages
Text:
How to Access your Earned Wages
When you download and open the Payactiv app, you will see your accessible balance for the hours you worked. 
Tap the blue dollar sign at the bottom of the screen and tap “Get”. 
Select how much of your accessible balance that you want, and where you want it distributed. (Payactiv® Visa Card*, another bank account, Amazon, cash, etc.). 
That’s it!

Text:
How to Transfer Your Earned Wages
To transfer your earned wages, first link your bank account or debit card to in the Payactiv app on the card page. Next, tap the blue dollar sign at the bottom of the homepage and tap “Get money”. Title: Get Paid Your Way: Understanding Your Accessible Balance with Earned Wage Access
Text:
Get Paid Your Way: Understanding Your Accessible Balance with Earned Wage Access
Earned Wage Access allows you to access a portion of your paycheck on-demand without having to wait until payday. This amount is your Accessible Balance, which resets after each pay period.
  The amount of your Accessible Balance depends on your employer's settings, with most employers opting for up to 50% of your paycheck to be made available at any given time. However, this may vary based on your employer's policies.
  By default, the maximum amount you can withdraw from your Accessible Balance is $750. However, if you set up paycheck Direct Deposit to the Payactiv® Visa Card*, you can access up to $1500 of your earned wages.
  It's important to note that your Accessible Balance is not a loan, and you won't accrue any interest or fees when you withdraw from it. Plus, with paycheck Direct Deposit, you can avoid costly check-cashing fees and have access to your funds even faster.

Remember, your Accessible Balance resets after each pay period, giving you the flexibility to use Earned Wage Access whenever needed.

Unfortunately, if you change jobs or your employer stops offering EWA, you may lose access to this benefit. But there is a solution: working for an employer that partners with a company like Payactiv.

It's easy to find a job that offers Payactiv EWA in the free Payactiv app. You can search for open jobs and save your favorite job postings.

Title: Payactiv EWA Isn't A Loan: It's Your Money On-Demand
Text:
Payactiv EWA Isn't A Loan: It's Your Money On-Demand
Earned Wage Access (or EWA) is an employer-offered benefit that gives you access to a portion of your paycheck before payday. We invented EWA in 2012 to provide financial flexibility and may help with financial stress between paydays for hardworking Americans like you.

EWA is not a loan. It's your money on demand. The money you get with EWA will come out of your regular paycheck. For example, Eric's typical payday is the 30th of each month. If he accesses $100 of his earned wages on the 15th, there will be $100 less on payday in a few weeks.

If your employer hasn't signed up for EWA yet, tell them about us! We'd love to see how we can help give you and your coworkers access to your earned wages.

Title: Card Not Working? How to Troubleshoot Common Card Issues For a Successful Transaction
Text:
Card Not Working? How to Troubleshoot Common Card Issues For a Successful Transaction
Is your card not working? This can happen for a number of reasons, but there are a few steps you can take to troubleshoot the issue.
  The first thing to check is whether your card is activated. Many cards require activation before they can be used, and if you haven't activated your card yet, that could be the reason it's not working. To check if your card is activated, call the number on the back of your card or the activation number provided by the issuer. Follow the instructions, and once it's activated, it should be ready to use.
  If your card is already activated and you're still having trouble using it, the next step is to check if there are sufficient funds on the card. If you don't have enough funds on your card, you may need to load more money onto it to complete your transaction. You can do this manually by transferring funds from another account or signing up for paycheck Direct Deposit, which automatically loads funds onto your card.
  If you're having trouble using your card for the first time:
Check if your card is activated by calling the activation number provided by the issuer.
If your card is not activated, follow the instructions provided to activate it.
If your card is activated, check if there are sufficient funds on the card.
Load funds onto your card manually or set up paycheck Direct Deposit to automatically add funds.
  If you continue to experience issues, give our card team a call at 1-877-747-5862.

Title: Payactiv Card Is Lost, Stolen, Or Seeing Suspicious Charges? We've Got Your Back
Text:
Payactiv Card Is Lost, Stolen, Or Seeing Suspicious Charges? We've Got Your Back
Payactiv® Visa Card*s are protected by the Visa Zero Liability Policy to protect you from unauthorized charges made with your account when your card is lost, stolen, or fraudulently used. We know it can be stressful, but we're here to help.
If you suspect unauthorized use, disable in the card dashboard of your Payactiv app so that it cannot continue to be used. 
Call Customer Success at 1-877-747-5862 so we can block your card if needed, transfer funds, start the investigation process, and send you a brand new card.
Please note: You must notify us immediately at 1-877-747-5862 of any unauthorized use. Requests over the weekend will be processed the next business day, and funds will be deposited by 6 pm EST.

Title: Setting up Automatic Bill Pay in Payactiv App: Funding Options
Text:
Setting up Automatic Bill Pay in Payactiv App: Funding Options
Setting up automatic bill pay in the Payactiv app is a convenient way to stay on top of your bills and avoid late fees. To get started, you'll need to make sure you have enough funds in your Payactiv account before each billing cycle. There are a few different ways to do this.
  One option is to set up direct deposit with Payactiv. Your paycheck will be automatically deposited into your Payactiv account each pay period, so you'll always have funds to pay your bills. Direct deposit is the recommended method for funding your Payactiv account because it's reliable, easy to set up, and ensures that your account stays topped up.
  Another way to add funds to your Payactiv account is to load money manually. You'll need to link a bank account to your Payactiv account to do this. Once your bank account is linked, tap the blue dollar sign at the bottom of the app home screen and tap "Get" to transfer funds from your linked bank account to your Payactiv account. This process is quick and easy, allowing you to add funds to your account whenever needed.
  It's worth noting that some banks may charge fees for transferring money to your Payactiv account, so be sure to check with your bank before using this method. Additionally, it's important to remember that you'll need sufficient funds in your Payactiv account before each billing cycle for automatic bill pay to work properly.
  Setting up automatic bill pay in the Payactiv app can save you time and hassle, and it's a great way to stay on top of your bills. Using one of the funding methods described above, you can ensure that you always have funds to pay your bills and avoid late fees.
